title: Refund Request
description: Request body for initiating a full or partial refund via POST /order/{orderId}/refund

requestId.description: Unique identifier for this refund request; must be unique per attempt to prevent duplicate refunds

amount.description: Amount to refund. May be less than the original order total for partial refunds.

isPlugin.description: Flag indicating the refund was initiated from a plugin integration

merchantRefundReference.description: Merchant's own reference for this refund
